source: Provincial Department of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries, Pursat Province — សារធាតុចិញ្ចឹមសម្រាប់ដំណាំស្រូវ (Nutrients for the Rice Crop), presenter Yem Sophy, 20 Nov 2017, p.26
text: Recommended fertilizer application rate (kg/ha), broken down by basal application, 1st top-dressing, 2nd top-dressing, and total: DAP (18-46-0) — 50 kg/ha basal, 0 kg/ha 1st top-dress, 0 kg/ha 2nd top-dress, 50 kg/ha total. UREA (46-0-0) — 27 kg/ha basal, 50 kg/ha 1st top-dress, 50 kg/ha 2nd top-dress, 127 kg/ha total. KCl (0-0-60) — 10 kg/ha basal, 20 kg/ha 1st top-dress, 20 kg/ha 2nd top-dress, 50 kg/ha total.
